claims.claim: The FAA issued a nationwide ground stop Friday afternoon after outdated air-traffic communications equipment became overloaded and began to fail.
claims.episode_span: issued a rare nationwide ground stop Friday afternoon after outdated air-traffic communications equipment became overloaded
claims.source_title: What to Know About Friday’s Nationwide Ground Stop
claims.supporting_quote: The Federal Aviation Administration issued a rare nationwide ground stop Friday afternoon, after outdated air traffic communications equipment became overloaded with data and began to fail, officials said.

claims.claim: Sean Duffy said radar and other air-traffic communications started to falter at 3:36 p.m. when old routers became overloaded.
claims.episode_span: radar and other communications started to falter at 3:36 p.m. when old routers overloaded
claims.source_title: What to Know About Friday’s Nationwide Ground Stop
claims.supporting_quote: Sean Duffy, the transportation secretary, told reporters at the White House Friday night that the radar and other air traffic communications started to falter at 3:36 p.m. when old routers became overloaded with data.

claims.claim: The New York Times said the outage stranded thousands of passengers.
claims.episode_span: The Times said the outage stranded thousands
claims.source_title: What to Know About Friday’s Nationwide Ground Stop
claims.supporting_quote: The outage stranded thousands of passengers and caused widespread delays from which airlines and airports are still struggling to recover.

claims.claim: NPR said millions of passengers were stranded and no planes were taking off.
claims.episode_span: NPR said millions of passengers were stranded and that no planes were taking off
claims.source_title: What we know about the FAA nationwide ground stop
claims.supporting_quote: No planes are taking off at any airport and millions of passengers are stranded.

claims.claim: Markwayne Mullin said there was zero evidence of a cyberattack and suggested new equipment added to old infrastructure overwhelmed the system.
claims.episode_span: zero evidence of a cyberattack and suggested new equipment and new technology
claims.source_title: What to Know About Friday’s Nationwide Ground Stop
claims.supporting_quote: “We’ve seen zero evidence that this was a cyberattack,” Mr. Mullin said, suggesting that new equipment and new technology the Mr. Duffy’s department had added to the old infrastructure was what had overwhelmed it.

claims.claim: Sean Duffy insisted the failure was caused by antiquated legacy equipment, not recent upgrades.
claims.episode_span: Duffy insisted the cause was antiquated legacy communications equipment, not recent upgrades
claims.source_title: What to Know About Friday’s Nationwide Ground Stop
claims.supporting_quote: Mr. Duffy insisted that the failure was caused by the antiquated, legacy communications equipment, not recent upgrades to the system.

claims.claim: Mark Carney said Canada had wrapped up trade talks with the Philippines and will not accept a US deal that kills the Canadian auto sector.
claims.episode_span: announced Canada had wrapped up talks on a trade agreement with the Philippines
claims.source_title: Canada making progress in USMCA talks to ensure long-term viability of auto sector, Carney says
claims.supporting_quote: Speaking to reporters during a trip to Manila, where he announced Canada had wrapped up talks on a trade agreement with the Philippines, Mr. Carney said that he won’t accept a deal with the United States that would kill the Canadian auto sector.

claims.claim: A 25 percent US tariff on Canadian-made autos, minus a US-parts carve-out, covers an industry that typically exports nearly 90 percent of production to the United States, and Canadian passenger-car and light-truck export value to the US fell nearly 12 percent from 2024 to 2025.
claims.source_title: Canada making progress in USMCA talks to ensure long-term viability of auto sector, Carney says
claims.supporting_quote: The value of Canadian passenger car and light truck exports to the U.S. tumbled nearly 12 per cent from 2024 to 2025, and exports are tracking even lower in 2026.

claims.claim: The Trump administration will let states wait until July to enforce a Medicaid work requirement planned for January 1.
claims.episode_span: It will now let states wait until July.
claims.source_title: Trump Administration Delays Enforcement of Medicaid Work Requirement
claims.supporting_quote: The federal government had planned to require poor adults to prove they were working or lose insurance coverage starting Jan. 1. Now, it will let states wait until July.
